Specification: This module specifies a small PlusCal algorithm with a single variable x initialized nondeterministically from the range 1..4 and a control-state variable pc introduced by the PlusCal translation. The algorithm contains a nested labeled if statement: from label a it branches on whether x < 3, then further branches on whether x equals 1 or 3, leading to labels b, c, d, or e where assertions check that the chosen branch matches the value of x. After any successful assertion, control moves to f, prints a message, and then terminates in a Done state; the temporal specification uses standard stuttering steps after termination and a weak fairness condition WF_vars(Next), and it also defines a liveness property asserting eventual termination.
IfThenElse: IF (x < 3) THEN /\ IF (x = 1) THEN /\ TRUE /\ pc' = "b" ELSE /\ pc' = "c" ELSE /\ IF (x = 3) THEN /\ TRUE /\ pc' = "d" ELSE /\ pc' = "e"
FunctionApplication: Assert(x = 1, "Failure of assertion at line 10, column 33.")
